chapter: British revival and the Crane River band
title: Other British bands: Lyttelton, Randall, George Webb
summary: Humphrey Lyttelton's band was top, Freddy Randall also good; Webb's Dixielanders were influenced by Lu Watters. Colyer only listened to Webb while on leave.
